title: ASAM MCD-1 XCP — Universal Measurement and Calibration Protocol
evidence: asam.net/standards/detail/mcd-1-xcp/ loaded live this session: standard title 'Universal Measurement and Calibration Protocol', current version 1.5.0, release date 30 Nov 2017. Also confirmed via the standard's own datasheet PDF listed on the same page (TOC_ASAM_AE_MCD-1-XCP_BS_Protocol-Layer_V1-5-0.pdf).
note: The bus-independent master/slave protocol by which measurement and calibration data physically leaves a running ECU; the exact seed the critic panel named as the pass's most embarrassing automotive omission (XCP 0 hits against 1 ASAM hit). Anchors the measurement x runtime-ops cell that round 1 never touched.

title: ASAM MCD-2 MC — ECU Measurement and Calibration Data Exchange Format (ASAP2 / A2L)
evidence: asam.net/standards/detail/mcd-2-mc/ loaded live this session: standard title 'ECU Measurement and Calibration Data Exchange Format', current version 1.7.1, release date 30 January 2018; also known as ASAP2, formats *.a2l and *.aml.
note: The description-file standard (A2L) that maps generated-code symbols to XCP-measurable/calibratable objects; emitted directly by Embedded Coder (see the paired coder.asap2.export tool-doc entry), making it the concrete D7 model-c <-> measurement bridge the mission calls out.

title: ASAM MDF — Measurement Data Format
evidence: asam.net/standards/detail/mdf/ loaded live this session: standard title 'Measurement Data Format', current version 4.3.0, release date 23 September 2025; binary channel-oriented format for post-measurement storage from ECUs/sensors/bus monitors.
note: The de-facto binary container every XCP/CANape/INCA measurement session and CMP bus capture ultimately writes to disk — the storage half of the measurement-and-calibration stack the critic panel named as fully missing (MDF 0).

title: ASAM ODS — Open Data Services
evidence: asam.net/standards/detail/ods/ loaded live this session: standard title 'Open Data Services', version 6.2.1, release date 26 Jan 2026.
note: The data-model/API standard for storing and retrieving structured test and measurement results (test benches, HIL rigs) — the long-term-archive counterpart to MDF's per-session file format; sibling standard the harvest would otherwise miss entirely.

title: ASAM XIL — Generic Simulator Interface (XIL API)
evidence: asam.net/standards/detail/xil/ loaded live this session: standard title 'Generic Simulator Interface', version 3.0.0, release date 30 September 2024; decouples test cases from MIL/SIL/HIL test benches.
note: The vendor-neutral API that lets a test case (requirements-stage artifact) run unmodified across MIL, SIL and HIL rigs; explicitly named in the mission and absent from both round 1 and the corpus.

title: ASAM MCD-3 D — Application Programming Interface Specification (MVCI Diagnostic Server)
evidence: asam.net/standards/detail/mcd-3-d/ loaded live this session: standard title 'Application Programming Interface Specification', version 3.0.0, release date 31 Oct 2011; defines the diagnostic-kernel API that interprets ODX (ASAM MCD-2 D) data descriptions for UDS/KWP2000/J1939 diagnostic communication.
note: The API layer sitting directly on top of the ODX data model the corpus already holds (ASAM MCD-2D) and the diagnostics protocols round 1 harvested (UDS/DoCAN/DoIP) — closes the tool-chain gap between the data format and the running diagnostic server.

title: ASAM MCD-3 MC — Application Programming Interface for Measurement and Calibration Server
evidence: asam.net/standards/detail/mcd-3-mc/ loaded live this session: standard title 'Application Programming Interface for Measurement and Calibration Server', version 3.0.0, release date 23 September 2011.
note: The measurement-side sibling of MCD-3 D: the API by which a test-automation or calibration client (e.g. CANape/INCA-class tools) drives an MC-server, closing the tool-chain layer directly above XCP/A2L.

title: ASAM MCD-1 CCP — CAN Calibration Protocol
evidence: asam.net/standards/detail/mcd-1-ccp/ loaded live this session: standard title 'CAN Calibration Protocol', version 2.1.0, release date 18 February 1999; page states explicitly 'The standard describes obsolete technology and has been replaced by ASAM MCD-1 XCP in the meantime,' kept published for legacy-system support.
note: XCP's direct, CAN-only predecessor — included as the lineage anchor for XCP (the ancestor-of-descendant lens the critic panel flagged as a systematic sweep miss) rather than as an independently active standard.

title: ASAM CMP — Capture Module Protocol
evidence: asam.net/standards/detail/cmp/ loaded live this session: standard title 'Capture Module Protocol', version 1.1.0, release date 26 Jan 2026; defines communication between bus/sensor capture-module probes and centralized data sinks (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet).
note: The newest ASAM member of the measurement stack (2026): standardizes centralized, scalable bus/sensor telemetry capture, directly serving D5's 'field data and telemetry from deployed devices' definition — a live-growing edge of the standard round 1 could not have found by citation-graph sweep alone.

note: The CAN-based network architecture standard for heavy-duty/off-road vehicles named directly in the mission; anchors the domain the corpus's automotive diagnostics harvest (UDS/DoCAN/DoIP/J1979) had no counterpart for outside light-duty road vehicles.
